ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Information Systems major students on Monday, December 7, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to undergraduate Finance, Accountancy, Operations Management, Marketing, Supply Chain Management, General Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering & Design and Innovation, Leadership and Engineering Entrepreneurship students as well as MSF, PMBA, MBA, MSM, MSBA and MSTM students on Monday, December 14, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
